Facility

Our facility.

Sand arena, round pen, locking tack rooms, indoor bathroom, and direct trail access — everything we have, in plain language.

Our facility

Four areas, laid out plainly.

  • 175'x 375' Sand Arena
  • 60' Shredded Rubber/Sand Round Pen
  • Access to Barrels, Stadium Jumps and Obstacles
  • Trail riding directly off property
  • Free Choice Hay
  • Bayco Fencing
  • Automatic Waterers
  • Individual & Group Pen Options
  • Multiple Locking Tack Rooms
  • Indoor Grooming Area
  • Outdoor Wash Rack
  • Indoor Bathroom
  • Trailer Parking
  • Automatic Entry Gate
  • Locked gates on both ends
  • Owners and a resident manager live on the property
  • Group pens and individual runs cleaned daily
  • Haychix slow feed nets & Hayhut feeders
